# Standard and Expert view now differ clearly in the device settings
### Changed
- **Standard and Expert view now differ clearly in the "Edit device" dialog** (about 57 visible controls in Standard instead of 133 in Expert view). Standard keeps what an ordinary person sets: name, background, seconds and zoom; for the display just a tick and a position per element; the permanent programme, memories and the night-rest times; the tablet check; note, greeting and simple access. Moved to Expert view: portrait pairs, size, colour, font and extra options of each display element, "take arrangement from", the look-ahead days, the calendar link, schedule, favourites, birthday photos, night rest by sunset, "party with guest photos" and "maintenance".

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
